property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract never returns true when given an empty _tos array (it reverts); the mutant allows _tos to be empty and returns true — so there exists an input (empty _tos) where the mutant returns true but the reference reverts.
change_summary: Change the require that enforces non-empty _tos to allow empty arrays by removing the require, so transfer may return true when _tos is empty.
